title: Heavenly Eye Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Cang Yutian moves like lightning, striking the exact center of Chen Ji's board—that is the fated eye of the Death Prophecy in Chapter 700!

text.content: The board of fate suddenly expands before Chen Ji's eyes, countless points of light cascading like a river of stars. He feels an intense pain from deep within his heavenly spirit, as if something that slumbered for millennia is awakening—the sign of resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and the Source of Fate. "You've finally arrived." An androgynous voice rings from all directions, carrying an oppressive majesty. "Ten thousand years of reincarnation, waiting precisely for this moment."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji grits his teeth against the dizziness, a cold sneer curling at the corner of his lips: "Wait? As if you were so innocent. Cang Yutian, just now weren't you saying our so-called bonds were an orchestrated script? How come you've changed your tune?" His voice echoes through the void, carrying unbridled mockery.

text.content: Before his words finish, the surrounding stars suddenly freeze. Countless images flash before Chen Ji's eyes like a carousel—all he experienced over seven hundred chapters: entering the sect as trash, stumbling upon the Tianji, Three Sect struggles, the Demonic Path Saint... Each scene is terrifyingly clear. Yet just then, a blurry figure suddenly cuts in, tearing apart all the images.

dialogue.content: "That is your end." The Heavenly Eye's voice iscalm得没有任何波澜，"In Chapter 700, the Source of Fate dries up. You self-destruct your divine soul to break the局, burning your Heavenly Fate to grant the living three years of respite. However—" The voice suddenly carries an imperceptible fluctuation, "Did you think this was the only ending?"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constrict sharply. The complete vision floods his consciousness: he sees himself standing at the center of the collapsing Source of Fate, the Tianji Record Fragment transforming into streaming light and entering his chest. He sees Su Qingyao drenched in blood shielding him, sees Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist torn apart. Finally, he sees his own head flying high—and in that moment, there is no fear in his eyes, only relief.

dialogue.content: "Heh." Chen Ji suddenly laughs, that smile as cold as a vengeful ghost crawled from hell, "Turns out my death was quite magnificent? However—" He suddenly lifts his head, eyes bursting with brilliant light, "You specifically let me see this, certainly not to visit my grave, right? Speak, what are the conditions."

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's resonance intensifies. Chen Ji feels his consciousness being pulled into a chaotic void, surrounded by endless chessboard patterns—each pattern is a possible timeline, and every choice he makes interweaves into complex designs within. "The Death Prophecy was never a curse." The Heavenly Eye's voice finally unveils a corner of the truth, "It is insurance."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's body jolts: "Insurance?" His mind races, countless clues connecting into a line before his eyes, "Are you saying... the death in Chapter 700, it was I—was the me from ten thousand years ago who designed it proactively?" His voice trembles slightly, an emotion he rarely displays.

text.content: The chessboard in the void dramatically shifts, countless points of light converging into an ancient scene: Chen Ji—no, a man identical to him yet with entirely different temperament, stands within the Source of Fate. Opposite him, a figure resembling the Heavenly Eye yet more ancient floats silently. "The Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago made a pact with me." The Heavenly Eye finally reveals that sealed truth.

dialogue.content: "He knew he would eventually face a certain death." The Heavenly Eye's voice actually carries... reverence? "So he laid his plans in advance, scattering the Tianji Record Fragments across the world, inscribing the Death Prophecy on each page. That was not a curse, but a key—when you can see through the death truth of Chapter 700, it means you have reached the final stage of the chess game."

text.content: Chen Ji feels a chill from the soles of his feet shooting straight to his heavenly spirit. If the Death Prophecy is a key... what was the meaning of Cang Yutian's cold smile just now? Just as he's about to ask, the scene transforms again: this time, what he sees is not his own death, but—a chess match. The Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago and the Heavenly Eye sit across from each other, their board in apocalyptic battle.

choice.prompt: The scene from ten thousand years ago continues playing, the Chen Ji from that era conducting the final match with the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji realizes, this is the key to changing fate! He must make a choice—

choices.description: Quietly observe the ancient match, seek weaknesses in the chess game, collapse this death trap laid ten thousand years ago from within
choices.risk_hint: Excessive Heavenly Fate consumption may affect subsequent judgment

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppresses his surging emotions, immersing his entire consciousness in that match from ten thousand years ago. The slaughter on the chessboard is brutal—each piece placed, countless threads of fate shatter along with it. His gaze is sharp as a hawk's, searching for that single flaw among countless variations. Suddenly, he sees it! The ancient self's move in desperation, subtly pointing to a corner ignored by all.

choices.description: Directly question the Heavenly Eye: since death is insurance, what is the meaning of Cang Yutian's current attack? Ask until the very end!

text.content: "Enough!" Chen Ji roared abruptly, cutting off Heaven's Eye's narration. "You said the death prophecy was insurance, but Cang Yutian just said it was a 'scripted design'! If it was insurance, why would he still attack my chess eye?" His voice exploded in the void, carrying an unquestionable interrogation.

choices.description: Remain silent, let Heaven's Eye continue speaking. Sometimes silence can force the opponent to reveal flaws more effectively than questioning
choices.risk_hint: May Fall into the Opponent's Rhythm

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply gazed quietly at that void, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his lips. Silence could sometimes be more lethal than countless words—he was gambling, wagering that Heaven's Eye would be more eager to confess than a living person. Indeed, moments later, that voice rang out again, carrying a trace of subtle anxiety: "You're clever. But time is running out."

The scene refocused. The Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago placed a piece, and the chessboard suddenly erupted with dazzling light—that light was not a declaration of victory, but the signing of some kind of covenant. "He traded this chess game for a possibility," Heaven's Eye's voice carried a complex emotion. "Win, and rewrite the inevitable death; lose, and fall into eternal damnation."

Chen Ji finally understood completely. The death prophecy in Chapter 700 was both an ending and a beginning. It was the last opportunity he left for himself to turn the tables—as long as he won the final chess match, he could completely rewrite his fate! And Cang Yutian's attack was precisely aimed at killing him first before he could find that crucial chess eye!

dialogue.content: "Now you know," Heaven's Eye's voice suddenly turned ice cold. "But what good does knowing do? Do you think Cang Yutian will give you this chance? His attack in reality has already landed—your chessboard, your destiny's eye, is exposed beneath his piece!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt an intense tremor coming from the outside world—that was Cang Yutian's attack tearing apart the resonance channel between him and Heaven's Eye! Time was critically short. The chess game from ten thousand years ago and the real-world crisis were overlapping at an alarming speed. If he couldn't find that crucial chess eye before Cang Yutian placed his piece, everything would fall into eternal damnation!

choice.prompt: The resonance channel violently trembled; Chen Ji had to make a decision before Cang Yutian placed his piece—

choices.description: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, forcibly unlock all chess game memories left by his past self ten thousand years ago, directly seize the crucial chess eye!
choices.risk_hint: Sharp Drop in Heavenly Fate May Cause Consciousness Collapse

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and forcefully activated the Tianji Record Fragment. The intense pain almost tore his consciousness apart, but what he gained in return was—massive memories flooding into his mind like a breached flood. He saw it! The chess eye his past self placed in the final moment ten thousand years ago was right there—at—

choices.description: Seek help from the remnant soul guardian within the Tianji Record, use the master's power to争取key time before Cang Yutian places his piece
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's Unstable Condition May Cause Accidents

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness instantly sank into the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's aged face appeared in the chaos. Before he could speak, Chen Ji urgently said: "Master, Cang Yutian is attacking my destiny's chess eye, I need time!" A gleam of light flashed in Mo Xiansheng's turbid eyes: "I'll buy you three breaths."

choices.description: Deliberately exposing the position of the Destiny Chess Eye, luring Cang Yutian into the trap left ten thousand years ago to turn the tables!
choices.risk_hint: Enduring Attack May Result in Severe Injury

text.content: A wild smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. Since his self from ten thousand years ago had already calculated this step, could the so-called Destiny Chess Eye... itself be a trap? He proactively released his defense on that chess eye position, letting Cang Yutian's attacks surge in like a tide—he was gambling, betting that his self from ten thousand years ago left him not just a dead end, but also a killing move to break the局的杀招！

Right at this moment, in the real world beyond the Void, an extremely sharp aura erupted suddenly. Cang Yutian's voice pierced through the resonant barrier, carrying a confident sneer: 'Found it—your Destiny Chess Eye is at the 'Tian Shu' position! Even if Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago were wiser, he never imagined I'd move faster than him!'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. He felt that fierce killing intent rapidly approaching his Destiny Chess Eye—that was the final foreshadowing left from his game against the Heavenly Eye ten thousand years ago, and the sole hope to change the certain death in Chapter Seven Hundred. Cang Yutian's move was set in stone, and he—must make the final choice before that!

text.content: 'Too slow.' Cang Yutian's voice was like the judgment of Death God, 'Once this piece falls, your Eye of Destiny will be completely shattered. The safety net from ten thousand years ago, the layout of ten thousand years—all will turn to nothing at this moment. And you—' his tone carried a hint of amusement, 'will witness yourself walking into death in Chapter Seven Hundred, then—fall into eternal reincarnation, never to turn the tide!'

Chen Ji stood at the intersection of chaos and reality, feeling that power capable of destroying everything approaching. His heart hammered like a drum, his blood boiling. The chess game his self from ten thousand years ago laid with his life, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul protection, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's bonds... everything will be reduced to ashes the moment Cang Yutian's piece falls.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's move is about to fall! Chen Ji must make the final choice—

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium, face Cang Yutian's attack head-on, and use his own Heavenly Fate Value to hard-counter this move!
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value Reaching Zero Will Result in Weakness

text.content: 'Dream on!' Chen Ji violently activated the Tianji Record Fragment, his entire body's Heavenly Fate Value pouring out like a flood. A brilliant golden light erupted from his body, forcefully blocking Cang Yutian's lethal move! The two forces collided in the Void, erupting in a deafening roar. Cang Yutian's move was forcefully intercepted, but Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value also plummeted to rock bottom...

choices.description: Proactively abandon the current chess eye position, guide Cang Yutian's attack toward the deadly trap left by his self ten thousand years ago, and turn the tables on him!
choices.risk_hint: May Completely Alter the Chess Game's Direction

text.content: Chen Ji sneered coldly, his figure flickering like a ghost. He deliberately left a phantom image at the 'Tian Shu' position, while the true Destiny Chess Eye—he had quietly moved to another location. What Cang Yutian's move shattered was merely an illusion! And his true killing move, precisely at the moment Cang Yutian made his move, was quietly being laid!

choices.description: Chen Nian is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' her existence will interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—perhaps it can also interfere with Cang Yutian's attack!
choices.risk_hint: May Put Chen Nian in Danger

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly shouted, his voice piercing through the barrier of destiny: "Chen Nian!" The name was like a thunderclap exploding in the chaotic void. Cang Yutian's chess move abruptly faltered—he sensed it! That "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" who had been kidnapped by the Holy Sect actually had such a deep bond with Chen Ji? In that instant of hesitation, Chen Ji's destined chess eye erupted with dazzling light!

Cang Yutian's move struck like lightning, targeting the very center of Chen Ji's chessboard—precisely where the destined eye of the seventh hundred chapter's death prophecy lay! The brilliant killing move tore through the void, carrying the overwhelming force to crush everything. Yet in that critical moment, Chen Ji witnessed something unprecedented: Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago, at the same moment, same second, faced the identical chess eye, placing a stone with devastating precision. This single move against Cang Yutian's attack created an absolutely flawless—Ko Fight!
